<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 10:4">Targ. Koh. X, 4</cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="N00251"><he>נְהִיג</he></cite>; pl. <he>נְהִיגִין</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 39:37">Targ. Y. Ex. XXXIX, 37</cite>.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 22a">Ber. 22ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 136b:11">Ḥull. 136ᵇ</cite> <he>נָהוּג עלמא כהני וכ׳</he> the world follows in practice the opinion of these three elders &c.
Gen. R. s. 33 שרי נָהֵיג ביה יקרא he began to do him honor (= h. נהג כבוד).—Part. pass. as ab. accustomed.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 4:1:7">Y. Pes. IV, 30ᶜ</cite> sq. <he>נשייא דנְהִיגָן … אינו מנהג</he> (not <he>דנהיגין</he>) that custom of the women not to do …, is no binding custom; ib.ᵈ top <he>דנַהֲגָן</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Rosh Hashanah 2:5:3">Y. R. Hash. II, 58ᵇ</cite> top <he>הכין אתון נ׳ גביכון וכ׳</he> is that your custom, to annoy your superiors?; a. fr.
